visual_action: A slideshow of six still photographs of Donald Trump in various settings, including formal portraits, speaking at a podium, and on a golf course. Each image has text overlaid on it making a critical claim about his presidency from a first-person perspective.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the sole person depicted in a series of photographs, and the on-screen text makes first-person claims about his alleged actions and policies.

audio_music: A slow, gentle, and somewhat melancholic piano track plays continuously throughout the video, identified as "Mia & Sebastian's Theme" from the movie "La La Land". The emotional tone of the music creates a sarcastic contrast with the critical on-screen text.

cultural_references: The background music is "Mia & Sebastian's Theme" from the 2016 film La La Land.
The post uses the common internet "me when..." meme format to frame its political criticisms.
central_claim: Donald Trump's presidency harmed the middle class, women's reproductive rights, the jobs market, and the national debt.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval and mockery of Donald Trump by framing his alleged negative policy outcomes in a sarcastic meme format.
